payload.reason: The evidence provides specific datasets used for evaluation in different tasks, including their sizes and validation/test sets.

claims.text: For English-to-German (En-De), the dataset consists of around 4.5 million sentence pairs from WMT 2014, with newstest 2013 for validation and newstest 2014 for testing.
For English-to-Vietnamese (En-Vi), the dataset contains around 133K sentence pairs from IWSLT 2015, with tst2012 for validation and tst2013 for testing.
For German-to-English (De-En), the dataset from IWSLT 2014 contains 160K sentence pairs, with a validation set of 7K sentences and a test set of around 7K sentences.
For image captioning, the evaluation was conducted on the Microsoft COCO 2014 dataset, which includes 123,287 images with 5 descriptive sentences each.
